root_cause: Task-specific learning projection was derived from Brain JSON, but the actual repository skill source inventory and consumption claim were not independently version-pinned in the existing preflight packet.
fix: Extend existing deterministic projection + preflight with bounded repository SKILL.md source inventory, SHA-256 digests, four mandatory baseline skill selections, legacy metadata warnings, and honest SOURCE_DISCOVERED_LOAD_READBACK_REQUIRED state.
prevention_rule: Before any material agent execution, pin selected repository skill sources by exact SHA-256 in the existing preflight. A discovered source is not proof of skill loading or application: require existing actor/execution activity evidence with source digest before claiming consumed; keep provider and production outcome gates independent. External standards or new tools enter as evaluated candidates only.
terminal_rule: Protected exact-HEAD Required and CodeQL success; protected merge; Skill Projection run on main; deterministic next-agent preflight and source digest readback. Real runtime skill-consumption and commercial outcomes require independent receipts and may remain unproven.
